items.desc: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.

Let your AI agents call your phone over VoIP, and call them back. Your phone rings like a real call, even locked; a voice AI talks it through and returns the transcript. Self-hosted, open source, no phone numbers or Twilio.
Web motion effects in plain JavaScript, written for your AI to build into your site. Free to use.
